quote: 9. Goejaba and Pikin Slee Photovoltaic Microgrid Project in Suriname The project is constructed in the two villages of Goejaba and Pikin Slee, with a total installed photovoltaic capacity of 673.2 kW and a total energy storage capacity of 2.6 MWh. It was put into operation in May 2020. The successful implementation of the project sets a precedent for Chinese enterprises to provide high-quality power services in vast areas overseas without electricity.
note: Opened POWERCHINA English Solar page 20 May 2025 (Goejaba/Pikin Slee 673.2 kW).
